params.message:
Cancelling a cancelled transport is a yes, and the window shows the page after a cancel

A cancel in the transport window only closed the window: the list behind it kept offering
"Aanvraag annuleren" for a request that was already cancelled. Cancelling again from there
was refused with "a paid transport can no longer be cancelled", for a transport nobody paid.

- TransportController::cancel answers success for a transport that is already cancelled.
- The window reloads the page after a cancel, like the row actions, and says why a refused
  cancel was refused instead of doing nothing.
- TransportController::returned says a cancelled transport is cancelled, instead of sending
  the overview back to "being processed", which polled and came back every three seconds.
- Rules R S4-10.12 and R S4-10.15 updated.
